description: This file contains functions and classes for preprocessing and converting Torch models to CoreML format, including quantization and metadata handling.

classes.name: ScalarType
classes.description: Defines scalar data types with integer identifiers.

classes.name: CoreMLComputeUnit
classes.description: Enumeration of compute units for CoreML (CPU, CPU and GPU, All).

classes.name: CoreMLQuantizationMode
classes.description: Enumeration of quantization modes for CoreML models.

methods.name: TensorSpec
methods.description: Creates a tensor specification tuple with shape and data type.

methods.name: CompileSpec
methods.description: Creates a compilation specification tuple with model parameters.

methods.name: preprocess
methods.description: Converts a Torch Script module into a CoreML model with optional quantization and metadata.
